notes: Revision 2 withdraws the 50 custom-session P3 cells: the platform has no selective egress and no attributable network denial telemetry for session pools, so those cells could never be measured. The 450-row plan is retained unmodified as the historical record with its own digest. The deployments, profiles and scenario lists here must match the matrix named in `matrix.file`; scripts/protocol.test.mjs enforces that against the declared digest so this file cannot drift from the frozen matrix. auditWindowSeconds tracks the ingestion latency documented by Microsoft (traffic analytics: 60-minute default interval, ingestion can take up to one hour).

withdrawn.reason: custom session pool exposes only a binary EgressEnabled/EgressDisabled. There is no configuration that denies one destination while allowing another, and no VNet, UDR or flow-log path for attributable denial evidence, so the P3 containment claim cannot be made on that deployment.
